massing.credit: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Toronto.
massing.source_crs: EPSG:3857 (despite WGS84 in the archive name)
massing.modifications: Cropped to 2.7km from origin; converted to local azimuthal equidistant metres; simplified extrusions; fictional host footprint excluded. Heights use MAX_HEIGHT/AVG_HEIGHT and SURF_ELEV. Not a survey. Scenic facade finishes use two glass palettes on taller massing and limestone/brick palettes on lower massing, with separate rough roof surfaces. These finishes are original approximations, not surveyed building materials.

interior: Original procedural Blender architecture, cabinetry and selected furniture, with the CC0 furnishings listed below.
textures: Original procedural images with deterministic seed 731, plus CC0 wood_floor and Travertine009 materials listed below.
provisional: Road widths, elevations and traffic operation
Exact host tower location and floor elevation

geography.source: City of Toronto topographic waterbodies and Toronto Centreline v2
geography.credit: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Toronto.
geography.modifications: Cropped and projected to local AEQD; simplified shoreline and triangulated land; buffered roads. Road widths, elevations, foliage and simulated traffic are artistic approximations. Elevated-road lane paint and barriers follow the existing centreline routes with scenic lane widths and heights.

environment_maps.note: Lighting proxy, not a Toronto panorama. Asset-specific Pisa attribution remains to be confirmed before final distribution.

furnishings.name: Modern Arm Chair 01
furnishings.modifications: Centre span extended into an inward-facing bench sofa while retaining arm/leg thickness; upholstery recoloured warm cream. Original mesh data retained for the separate reading chair. Authored collision bounds and front approach derive from placed geometry.

floor_material.name: Wood Floor
floor_material.modifications: Derived light-oak albedo finish with reduced contrast; uniform satin roughness 0.52. Normal-map XY amplitude baked to 0.05 and renormalized because Bevy 0.15.3 ignores glTF normalTexture.scale. Original source textures retained unchanged.

parks.source: City of Toronto GIS City Park layer
parks.license_note: The dataset web page identifies this licence; the CKAN metadata says notspecified.
parks.credit: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Toronto.
parks.modifications: Public Park and Open Green Space classes cropped to scene land. Tree placement, height and species are scenic approximations, not a tree inventory. The 45 trees within 600 m use deterministic branched broadleaf geometry with 1600 leaves each; distant canopies use simpler geometry. Tree placement and mapped clearances are unchanged.

vehicles.source: Original procedural Blender vehicle from scripts/condo/build.py
vehicles.variants: Six original paint palettes; scripts/condo/vehicle_variants.py creates glTF scenes sharing unchanged geometry buffers. No surveyed vehicle types or live traffic data.
vehicles.lamps: Original front and rear lenses authored by scripts/condo/vehicle_lamps.py. Night-only cloned emission and one unshadowed headlight spot per car; scenic prototype, not surveyed lighting or braking behaviour.

street_lights.source: Original procedural Bevy fixtures in src/cc_render/bevy_app/street_lights.rs
street_lights.description: Scenic poles derived from existing traffic routes at 40 m spacing within 1400 m of the condo. Shared original geometry and materials; night-only warm emission and unshadowed road pools with cones constrained below the horizon. Locations, heights and photometry are artistic approximations, not surveyed Toronto infrastructure.

night_windows.source: Original procedural city_windows.wgsl and Bevy material extension
night_windows.description: Static scenic occupancy from window cells and wall origin; warm/cool pane emission on authored facade batches only. No real occupancy data, point lights, lake reflection or diffuse bounce is claimed.

coffee_table_stone.modifications: Coffee table only. 1.2 m UV0 repeat, original colour, softened OpenGL normal (0.10 XY amplitude), honed roughness 0.38 + 0.65 times source roughness. Geometry, transforms and existing sky-irradiance UV1 atlas preserved.

tabletop_details.description: Hollow lathed ceramic mug with rounded rim, handle and coffee surface; cloth-bound decorative book with covers, page block, spine and original FIELD NOTES lettering. No real publication represented. Decorative assets only, without new avatar actions.
tabletop_details.placement: Bases derive from the current coffee-table top; authored horizontal positions retained.
tabletop_details.lighting: Coffee-table sky irradiance refreshed at 128 samples on the existing UV1 atlas. Other room lightmaps preserved. See floor-bake.json surface_updates.

upholstery.scope: Living sofa and reading chair cushion faces only
upholstery.finish: Unmodified beige woven polyester colour and roughness; normal XY amplitude 0.2
upholstery.uv: UV0 smart projection at source dimensions; wood UV and baked UV1 preserved
upholstery.geometry: Unchanged; no avatar or motion edits

balcony_furniture.wood_finish: Unmodified colour sampled within unbroken boards at 1.7 m scale, aligned with timber length; existing softened normal with XY amplitude 0.05; roughness 0.60.
balcony_furniture.cushions: Existing CC0 Poly Haven Terlenka material and source-scale UVs.
balcony_furniture.collision: Three conservative static geometry-derived boxes; no seating/support declarations. Physical overhang retained and its incorrect navigation flag removed.
balcony_furniture.lighting: Balcony-only sky irradiance refreshed; other room lightmaps unchanged.
balcony_furniture.checker: scripts/condo/check_balcony_clearance.py; static XZ probes and conservative continuous central-route bound, not avatar traversal acceptance.

dining_furniture.chairs: Four curved upholstered backs, tapered oak legs, rails and thinner seats; one mesh with two material primitives per chair.
dining_furniture.table: Rounded 1.6 m diameter honed travertine top and fluted oak pedestal.
dining_furniture.materials: Existing CC0 wood_floor, Poly Haven Terlenka and ambientCG Travertine009 maps; no new downloaded assets.
dining_furniture.lighting: Floor-only sky irradiance refreshed at 512 x 512, 128 samples, seed 731; existing UV1 and lightmap bindings preserved.
dining_furniture.limitations: Visual furniture only; dining colliders and seating affordances are not yet registered. No avatar traversal or seating acceptance.

details: Oak veneer drawer and door fronts with metal pulls
Hollow base cabinet shell, boolean countertop cutout, recessed steel sink and arched faucet
Induction hob markings, oven, extractor hood and refrigerator
Travertine island top and waterfall ends
kitchen.materials: Existing CC0 light oak and travertine maps; authored metal, ceramic and recess materials.
kitchen.collision: Seven geometry-derived static bounds; base units, fridge and island participate in XZ navigation. Upper units, backsplash, hood and faucet retain separate physical boxes.
kitchen.lighting: Six existing sky-irradiance atlases refreshed from the saved lightmapped scene, preserving its geometry and UVs.
kitchen.limitations: Static visual appliances; no door/drawer actuation, water flow, cooking, sink cavity collision or grasp/seating validation. Grouped box bounds are conservative.
kitchen.island_layout: Centre and 1.15 m width preserved; length reduced from 2.65 m to 2.30 m, leaving a 0.78 m north passage.
kitchen.clearance: scripts/condo/check_kitchen_clearance.py verifies a static corridor with the existing 0.35 m planning reserve; not avatar traversal proof.

details: Upholstered oak headboard and puffed linen pillows
Static sage duvet with shallow folds and side/foot drape
Two-drawer bedside unit, stone top and ceramic lamp with hollow linen shade
bedroom.materials: Existing CC0 oak, Terlenka fabric roughness/normal and travertine maps. Sage fabric colour is authored; source images are unchanged.
bedroom.lighting: Nine normalized-sky atlases, including bedroom rug, mattress and continuous duvet atlases. Authored bedside point light: 600 lm, 3.5 m range, 0.08 m radius, warm sRGB [1, 0.78, 0.52]; position derived from shade bounds. Shade uses a cloned emissive material and does not cast shadows to approximate linen transmission. Geometry and all 18 lightmap files remain unchanged by the lamp addition.
bedroom.collision: Four conservative geometry-derived groups: bed, headboard, bedside unit and lamp; lamp excluded from XZ navigation. No lying/sitting/contact affordances.
bedroom.clearance: scripts/condo/check_bedroom_clearance.py verifies static west and east access corridors against the 0.35 m planning reserve.
bedroom.limitations: Static bedding only; no avatar cloth dynamics or interaction. Lamp is always on; no time-based switching. Point light and emissive shade approximate a fabric luminaire; no physical shade transmission or indirect lamp bounce.
bedroom.duvet_atlas: Continuous top and underside UV1 rectangles with a separate padded rim strip; 20.48 texel top/underside separation at 512 px with 8 px bake margins. Geometry and fabric UV0 preserved; duvet-only rebake in iteration 106.
